key_insights.title: Landing Hardware is Critical
key_insights.description: LandingPadUsed and LandingHardwareScore are among the top predictors, confirming that proper landing infrastructure is essential for success.

key_insights.title: Experience Matters
key_insights.description: ReusedCount and cumulative flight features show that SpaceX's learning curve significantly impacts landing success.

key_insights.title: Payload Mass Impact
key_insights.description: Higher payload mass relative to capacity negatively affects landing probability, as expected from physics.

key_insights.title: Hardware Configuration
key_insights.description: Legs and GridFins deployment are positive indicators, as they are required for controlled landing.

key_insights.title: Historical Success Trends
key_insights.description: Rolling success rates (OverallRollingSuccess_5) indicate that recent performance is a strong predictor.
